scenes.conflict: The satellite's shifting heat patterns leave little time, and Oren's emergency-first priorities make him reluctant to spare anyone or anything for a vault expedition.
scenes.goal: Mira wants to identify a way to protect Westglass before the cooling system fails.
scenes.outcome: Mira establishes that ordinary repairs may not be enough; Oren authorizes a short search for a solution but insists Westglass comes first.
scenes.summary: A new satellite track puts Westglass in the path of an intensifying heat event. Mira diagnoses worsening strain in the cooling network and urges an expedition to find the Quiet Vault, while Oren argues that every available resource must go to immediate repairs.
scenes.title: A Cooling System in Peril

scenes.conflict: Ilyan's secrecy blocks the mission, while Mira's impatience and Oren's demand to prioritize Westglass make both of them press for control over the vault's resources.
scenes.goal: Mira wants Ilyan to reveal the vault's location and help find a way to mislead the satellite.
scenes.outcome: Ilyan agrees to lead Mira to the vault if they seek a fair sharing plan; Oren allows the expedition but expects its first useful resources to go to Westglass.
scenes.summary: Ilyan, who has come to Westglass from the Canopy Keepers, admits that he found traces of the Quiet Vault beneath an abandoned agricultural station. He explains that its living root seal needs measured warmth and moisture, but still resists revealing its location until there is a plan to protect and share its seeds.
scenes.title: The Botanist's Secret

scenes.conflict: Sela distrusts official Greenhold missions and demands that Reedline's independence and place in seed decisions be respected; Mira's impatience risks turning negotiation into another demand.
scenes.goal: Mira and Ilyan need Sela's guidance to cross the Glass Waste and reach the Quiet Vault in time.
scenes.outcome: Mira accepts an exchange: Reedline will be included in the seed plan, and useful findings will be shared. Sela agrees to guide them.
scenes.summary: After a water-conscious journey from Westglass, Mira and Ilyan reach Reedline and ask Sela for the Wayfinders' safer crossing. Sela refuses to hand over route knowledge as though it were a resource the Greenholds can simply claim.
scenes.title: A Route Is Not a Gift

scenes.conflict: Mira distrusts a route she cannot verify with instruments, while the official chart offers no reliable way to judge the changing terrain.
scenes.goal: The travelers need to cross the basin without losing their water or missing the window to reach the vault.
scenes.outcome: Mira follows Sela's guidance; the group reaches the far side with enough water, but the delay makes the approaching heat event feel immediate.
scenes.summary: Sela leads the pair through the Glass Waste by following scrub patches and reciting a route song updated for shifting springs. When Mira's inherited chart points toward a faster, exposed crossing, Sela's route proves safer but costs precious time.
scenes.title: The Song Through the Basin

scenes.conflict: Mira's belief that technical urgency justifies acting alone puts the root system at risk; Ilyan's careful method requires patience they may not have.
scenes.goal: Mira and Ilyan need to open the Quiet Vault without destroying its living seal.
scenes.outcome: Mira yields to Ilyan's expertise, and together they open the seal without damaging it.
scenes.summary: At the buried station, Mira tries to speed the Quiet Vault's living entrance with a quick application of warmth and moisture. Ilyan stops her before the roots are harmed and shows her how to bring the conditions into balance gradually.
scenes.title: Measured Warmth

scenes.conflict: The records offer a possible defense but no guarantee, and Mira's urgency tempts her to take the vault's resources for Westglass alone.
scenes.goal: Ilyan wants to secure the seeds and knowledge for fair distribution, while Mira needs a practical way to protect Westglass.
scenes.outcome: They take the records and a measured seed allotment, agreeing that the information and seeds must be shared with Reedline and the Canopy Keepers.
scenes.summary: Inside the Quiet Vault, Ilyan and Mira find climate-hardy seeds and records from the old satellite network. The records confirm that broad bands of flowering plants can register as cool cloud cover; the blooming gardens at Westglass may help confuse the satellite if they are protected rather than sacrificed for power.
scenes.title: What the Flowers Remember

scenes.conflict: The safe route is changing, and Sela's distrust flares when the others discuss the findings as though Reedline's knowledge were theirs to use.
scenes.goal: The group must return to Westglass with the records and seeds before the heat event arrives.
scenes.outcome: Mira and Ilyan treat Sela as a partner in the plan; she shares the route adjustments that get them back to Westglass with the evidence intact.
scenes.summary: Sela guides the group back across the Glass Waste, updating her route song as wind shifts the mineral dust. Mira shares the satellite findings with her, and Ilyan explains how Reedline can take part in protecting and distributing the seeds.
scenes.title: A Shared Way Back

scenes.conflict: Oren's need to protect residents makes him treat control over allocation as control over the outcome; Ilyan fears the vault will be claimed, and Mira must persuade Oren without dismissing the risks he sees.
scenes.goal: Oren wants to secure Westglass's cooling system, while Mira and Ilyan seek support for a plan that preserves the gardens and shares the vault's resources.
scenes.outcome: Oren agrees to a joint response: urgent cooling repairs continue, and a limited share of reclaimed water keeps the flowering gardens alive through the satellite's pass.
scenes.summary: Mira and Ilyan present the vault records to Oren, while Sela insists that Reedline be included in the response. Oren argues for directing water and effort to the cooling system alone, leaving the public gardens to wither; Mira lays out why those flowering bands may be Westglass's best chance.
scenes.title: The Cost of First

scenes.conflict: The water is scarce, the satellite's damaged models are unpredictable, and any failure could leave Westglass exposed despite the repairs.
scenes.goal: The group must preserve Westglass's cooling long enough for the flowering gardens to confuse the satellite's heat estimates.
scenes.outcome: The satellite reads the broad flowering band as cool cloud cover and shifts its heat pattern away from Westglass; the cooling network holds through the immediate danger.
scenes.summary: As the heat event approaches, Mira uses the vault records and her heat-pattern analysis to anticipate the satellite's readings. Ilyan identifies which flowering plots can tolerate the water, Sela helps coordinate the plan with Reedline's route knowledge, and Oren keeps the cooling repairs supplied while the gardens are protected.
scenes.title: A Band of Bloom

scenes.conflict: Reedline has reason to distrust another promise from the Greenholds, while the seeds need careful stewardship rather than hurried distribution.
scenes.goal: The three want a practical plan for distributing the vault's seeds and restoring a flowering corridor beyond the Greenholds.
scenes.outcome: They agree on a shared seed plan that gives Reedline a meaningful role in stewardship and makes the vault's knowledge available beyond Westglass.
scenes.summary: With the immediate threat past, Mira and Ilyan bring the seed records and agreed allotment to Reedline. Sela helps set the terms for caring for the seeds and sharing useful route and growing knowledge without surrendering Reedline's independence.
scenes.title: Terms for Growing

scenes.conflict: Council caution and Oren's old emergency-first instincts threaten to narrow the agreement back to Westglass alone.
scenes.goal: Oren wants the Council to sustain Westglass repairs while supporting the shared seed-corridor effort.
scenes.outcome: Oren backs a plan for continued cooling repairs and shared seed knowledge; Mira and Ilyan leave the vault's future in a cooperative effort rather than under one group's control.
scenes.summary: Back in Westglass, Oren presents the joint response to the Lattice Council: cooling repairs remain urgent, but seed stewardship and the flowering corridor are part of protecting the Greenholds, not a diversion from it. Mira commits her technical work to the shared plan, and Ilyan entrusts the records to the wider effort.
scenes.title: The Lattice Holds

logline: As a rogue weather satellite drives a heat event toward Westglass, engineer Mira and botanist Ilyan must earn Reedline’s trust, open a living-sealed seed vault, and persuade a divided council to share the knowledge and water that could turn flowering plants into Westglass’s last defense.
theme: Survival takes root when knowledge and resources are shared.
title: Greenhold
